changelog:
- Initial release of the mint-artblocks-token skill.
- Provides tools and workflow to mint (purchase) Art Blocks tokens, including support for set price, Dutch auction, allowlist, RAM, and holder-gated minters.
- Includes minting mechanics, project discovery, minter configuration, eligibility checks for gated projects, and transaction building (ETH set price only).
- Supports multiple chains: Ethereum mainnet, Arbitrum, and Base.
- Offers guidance on unsupported minter and currency types, allowlist profile checks, and gifting options (purchaseTo).
